matches.description: For a full-dimensional rational polytope with one labelled coordinate axis and a complete irredundant V-representation, compute the exact support value h_P(u)=max_{x in P}<u,x> and return every maximizing vertex as the complete exposed face. The exact support kernel is one bounded vertex-by-covector pass; the V-value separately proves that each supplied generator is an extreme vertex before evaluation.
matches.title: Compute an exact rational polytope support value

matches.description: Return the canonical exact decomposition f = R' + H over QQ(x), where H is proper with square-free denominator. The result also completely decides whether f has a rational primitive; a nonzero H does not rule out a formal primitive involving logarithms. The current conservative envelope admits numerator degree 6, denominator degree 3, and two-digit rational coefficient components.
matches.title: Reduce a rational function modulo exact derivatives

matches.description: Compute the invariant factors, characteristic polynomial, and minimal polynomial of a square rational matrix via Smith normal form of tI - A over QQ[t].
matches.title: Compute the exact rational (Frobenius) canonical form

matches.description: Return an inconsistency witness or a consistent outcome.
matches.title: Compute an exact rational inconsistency witness
